title: Add a data source (API or MCP server)
summary: Describe the data you need, your budget and your limits. WordBench looks in its own catalogue, the APIs.guru directory, the official MCP Registry and the web; researches each candidate from its own pages (only facts backed by a quote are shown); scores how well each fits your brief; and stops at one approval gate where you read the provider's terms and decide. APIs and MCP servers are labelled apart. An API is activated only if all tests pass; MCP servers are found and recommended, not installed yet.

need.title: What data do you need?
need.description: In your own words. For example: patent family records for European filings since 2015

fields.title: Facts or fields it must return
fields.description: One per line. For example: publication number, applicant, priority date

examples.title: Example questions or records
examples.description: One per line: what you would ask it

coverage.title: Coverage
coverage.description: Countries, time span or entities. For example: EU and US, 2015 to now

freshness.title: How fresh must the data be?

commercial_use.title: I will use the data commercially

identity_ok.title: I can complete an identity check if the provider requires one

api_name.title: A source you already have in mind (optional)

docs_url.title: Its official documentation URL (needed with the name)
